name: explosion
description: An explosion, played once per event: the game calls instance.trigger('explode', strength), strength 0 .. 1 (0 is silent). It shows layering and an event parameter: three layers, each scaled by the strength. The crack: white noise through a low-pass that closes, from 400 + 7000 * strength Hz down to 100 .. 150 Hz, as exp(-5 p) of a sequence's phase p over the explosion's 1.4 .. 1.8 s; decay time constant 0.25 s. The thump: a sine that drops from 120 Hz to 40 Hz (time constant 80 ms, from the seconds since the event, boom.phase * boom.length), decay 0.3 s. The tail: noise through two low-passes at 150 + 250 * strength Hz, a 20 ms attack and a long decay (time constant 0.7 s), cut to zero 4 s after the event. A stronger event is louder and brighter. Then into tanh.
